idea-plugin.name: mcpgawk: see every MCP server your agents can reach
idea-plugin.description:
Your agents call MCP servers you have never inspected. This plugin shows every server configured across your AI tools, grouped by the tool it lives in, what each one can reach, and which ones need attention.

Blocking a call and catching post-approval drift are the mcpgawk CLI and its panel, not this tool window.

Local-first. The plugin runs the mcpgawk CLI on your machine and renders what it returns. Nothing about your servers or credentials is uploaded anywhere.

Requires the engine: pipx install mcpgawk.
